newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended stronger against hard currencies on Friday on the back of export inflows, largely from the continuing annual tobacco auctions, dealers said.
"There was a lot of money around and some guys were selling in the market. I know one bank sold U.S.$6 million today," one dealer said.

The local unit finished Friday's interbank session firmer at 10.1900/2600 against the U.S. dollar from 10.2200/2700 previously, while against pound sterling it was quoted at 15.9500/0670 from 16.0360/1200.
It edged up against the German mark to 6.8550/9040 from 6.8910/9275 and was at 2.2610/2790 versus the South African rand, up from Thursday's 2.2720/2840.
